Destruction system
It wouldn't be a combat module without an expanded
system. We've added a new system to the game.
We know what a destroyed ship looks like.
We've added a new system.
Destruction
During combat, you likely take a few hits.
A grav component has 80% chance to turn into
a destroyed variant of that component.
Destroyed grav pieces can be repaired,
but they can still be deconstructed to yield
resources.
Deconstructing a working thruster yields
2 steel and 2 components.
Destroying a small astrof yields 45 steel and
1 component.
Deconstructing a destroyed small astrof yields
2 components.
Majority of grav components have a destroyed variant.
These destroyed variants appear in new locations such as
derelict gravships.
...and more.

Gravship detection
We need system in place to ensure that the
gravship threat is not a random event.
We have an internal visibility counter to determine
the threat level.
Visibility counter
Visibility counter drops over time at the rate of 2700
per day.
This means that the lower your visibility, the
less likely you are to be detected.

Incoming warplatform
Warplatform
An enemy warplatform is a grav platform that will fight off an orbital bombardment. It is a massive, heavily armed platform that will ensure you cannot take it down with a single well-placed shot.
Upon detection
An orbital bombardment platform has activated its grav signature. The platform will begin firing at you. You must destroy this component to disable the platform.
The platform will continue to fire on you until you are out of range or it is destroyed. You must find a way to escape the platform.
Point defense turrets, gravtor, and grav generators are used to protect the platform. You must destroy these to weaken the platform.
You are given 48 hours to prepare. If you have a signal jammer, this time is extended to 24 hours.
Escaping a grav platform
Escaping a grav platform will slightly reduce your visibility and temporarily reduce the encounter.
Warplatform
Upon arrival
An orbital warplatform has arrived and is actively engaging your grav. You must neutralize the platform by destroying its defenses or by boarding the platform and destroying its gravcore.
You can fight back by destroying the platform's defenses or by boarding the platform and destroying its gravcore.
The game generates a warplatform orbital location near your grav.
You can fight back by destroying the platform's defenses or by boarding the platform and destroying its gravcore.

Quest Rewards
New Quest rewards have been added in this module, pushing the capabilities of the gravship.
Rewards can be found in sealed containers across the world.
We focus on improving your gravship, you guessed it, also new!
Warcomputer
The tactical supercomputer core of a gravship.
It enhances the gravship's defenses and weapons.
It can improve the gravship's combat capabilities.
It draws power directly from the gravship.
Warcomputer improves combat capabilities of the gravship.
Accuracy of Gauss increased by 15%
Accuracy of Gauss increased by 22%
Rate of fire of Javelin increased by 33%
Rate of fire of Javelin increased by 33%
Burst of Anti-aircraft increased by 50%
Point defense turret projectile intercept radius increased by 33%
Gravcloaker
A specialized device that masks a gravship.
It reduces the impact of the gravship on the planet, making it less likely the gravship is detected.
Gravcloaker reduces visibility gained from gravship by 15%
Grav field dilutor
An advanced utility that slightly reduces the gravity around a gravship.
It allows the gravship to support one grav field dilutor.
Grav field dilutor reduces gravship's maximum size by 250
Astrofire launcher
A compact multi-missile platform that can be mounted on a gravship.
It fires a volley of astrofire at a target.
It requires a linked targeting terminal.
Astrofire launcher requires a linked targeting terminal.
Astrofire launcher stats:
World map: 16
Burst shot: 4
Warm up: 6 seconds
Blast: 5
Ammunition shot: 30 astrofire
Astrofire launcher connects to astrofire network for automatic reloading.
Emergency gravship generator
An emergency power source.
It can provide power to the gravship in emergencies.
It can generate power up to 50,000 W.
Emergency gravship generator is a unique building that can be placed on a gravship.
When activated, it generates power to cover the power deficit of the gravship.

Starting Scenario
There is a new Starting scenario which allows you to dive straight into gravship combat giving you a jump start to gravship progression. You will start with a gravship already built, a gravship already built, a gravship already built. Whether you survive long enough to see it, it remains to be seen.
The Gravship
Your gravship engine is burning. You managed to drift into an empty patch of orbit to bleed off the heat. The cool down is excruciatingly slow. You know your pursuers are right behind you. It's a matter of time before they find you. You must patch your ship, patch your crew, and prepare for boarding.
Note: This is a difficult scenario and is not recommended for new players.
In this scenario, the gravship engine will be on cooldown for several hours.
Gravship
You start with a gravship that is somewhat equipped.
You start with 6 crew members with a chance to be lost.
The gravship engine will be on cooldown for 9 hours.
You start with a gravship with a local visibility of 460.
You start with basic gravship, gravship living, oxygen, and a basic gravship network.
It is recommended that you escape as soon as you can. Your starting gravship is not equipped to take an enemy gravship.
